thread:
amanda_sales: Quick heads-up — United Systems POC hitting procurement stage. They asked for: countersigned order form, DPA appendix redlines, and confirmation on SLA penalties. PO is 'pending' on their side. @jordan_legal can you advise on SLO/penalty language we can accept?

jordan_legal: Thanks — can you drop their redlines or the doc link? Need to see if they added any export/retention bans. Also, do they request exec signature or delegated signer?

amanda_sales: Link to their package: https://internal.redwood/contracts/USC-PO-1234 — redlines attached. They proposed a hard data export prohibition in the DPA appendix and asked for SLA 99.9% with 4hr incident response. PO snippet below:

```
PO#: 2026-4551
Billing entity: United Systems Corp
Amount: $45,000
Billing cycle: Annual
Requested signer: procurement@usc.example.com (delegated)
```

carlos_procure: From procurement side — we need their W9/tax certificate and remit-to address before we can accept the PO. Also need to confirm net terms (they put Net30). Is Finance okay with Net30?

sean_finance: Net30 is fine for mid-market; for enterprise deals we prefer Net45 but can approve Net30 with center-of-risk review. Also requires PO number on invoice — confirm that with customer.

nira_se: Operational note — SLA 99.9 + 4hr response is above our hosted defaults. For Dedicated we can consider it with an exception and penalty cap. We should surface that as: "99.9% uptime for production endpoints; credit = min(3x monthly invoice, actual loss)" — Jordan, can we propose a cap?

jordan_legal: Suggest cap = 3x monthly recurring charges and remove open-ended liability. On DPA export ban, propose replacing with: "Data export restricted to jurisdictions agreed in Appendix B; limited exceptions for incident response and legal process." I'll prepare a tracked-redline and upload.

amanda_sales: Customer also requested delegated signer (procurement team). Is delegated signing acceptable or do we need exec + procurement?

jordan_legal: Delegated signing ok if the signer is explicitly authorized by an exec and email domain matches corporate domain. We need a signed authorization letter or an email confirmation from a VP/CFO. Add a clause mapping signer roles to authority in the order form.

carlos_procure: Procurement will accept delegated signer with: (1) signed PO, (2) official domain email, (3) director-level approval in cc. We'll run a quick KYC.

sean_finance: Also need W9 and TAX ID upfront. Amanda — can you ask them to attach the W9 and remit-to to the DocuSign envelope? Finance will not process without it.

amanda_sales: Will do. Drafting a short checklist to send to the buyer now: PO, W9, remit info, signer name/email, exec authorization, and billing contact. Preview: 

"Hi — to finish countersignature we need: PO#, signed PO scanned or DocuSign envelope, W9/tax cert, remit-to address, signer name/email and a short note from your CFO authorizing the delegated signer, and the billing contact. Also confirm SSO/SAML contact if you want SSO set up during onboarding.

Thanks, Amanda (Redwood)"

nira_se: Also flagging SSO/KMS notes — if they require KMS in their region we'll need the private deployment playbook. Might shift to Private offering; flag for sales motion.

amanda_sales: Noted. I'll mark that on the opportunity. I'll send the checklist and ask them to attach docs to the DocuSign envelope.

```bash
# quick docuSign create (internal snippet)
rdw-sign create --template orderform-v2 --recipient procurement@usc.example.com --tags PO#:2026-4551
```

deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0x9f3a) by amanda_sales — awaiting recipient signature. :white_check_mark:

amanda_sales: Thanks everyone — Jordan, upload redline when ready and I'll attach to the envelope. I'll also loop in the customer success manager once signed for onboarding scheduling.

jordan_legal: Uploaded tracked redline here: https://internal.redwood/contracts/USC-PO-1234/redline_v1 — main changes: SLA cap, DPA export wording, signer role mapping. Will follow up if they push more.

amanda_sales: Perfect — sending checklist to the buyer now. I'll update this thread with PO received and signed envelope id. :thumbsup:
